title: Expected top quality from Corelle
text:
Expected top quality from Corelle. I am shocked at the poor quality of this Corelle product. The rims of all 6 cups are sharp with tiny chips all around. I cant let kids use any of these - throwing them out. These must be “seconds” and should be advertised as such.
Also, there is a Corelle sticker on the bottom of all 6 cups which are so annoying to try and remove.

product_metadata.title: Corelle Coordinates by Reston Lloyd Splendor Acrylic Stemless Wine Glasses (Set of 4), 16 oz, Clear
features: Set includes four 16-Ounce acrylic stemless wine glasses for indoor or outdoor use
Made from high grade acrylic/plastic to provide glass like quality and clarity and greater durability
Features a lightweight glass with Corella Coordinates Splendor pattern
BPA free; use for cold beverages only; dishwasher safe
Coordinates to match Corella Coordinates dinnerware and accessories
description: Reston Lloyd produces high quality enamel on steel kitchen, melamine, and acrylic accessories to produce Corelle Coordinates as well as their private brand Calypso Basics. In addition, Reston Lloyd is the exclusive distributor for both Romertopf and MAWA which are home & kitchen products from Germany. These high end quality products are one of the cornerstones to Reston Lloyd, who focuses on quality merchandise from Germany. For nearly 30 years, we have been dedicated to providing the highest quality products, with an equal emphasis on superior customer service. This Corelle Coordinate Glass Set is made of durable, BPA free plastic/acrylic. This lightweight stemless wine glass holds 16 ounces, measures 3.75-inch diameter by 4.75-inches high and is dishwasher safe.
